title: Change the colors
subtitle: A deck's theme.css overrides the template's colors and fonts
bullets: The template's look is a set of named values: `--accent`, `--bg-slide`, `--font`, and more
A presentation gives them new values in its own `theme.css`
task: In the file below, remove the two comment marks around the block that sets `--accent`, and save. The whole deck changes color. This task cannot tick itself.
ask: In the tutorial deck, switch on the alternative accent colors in theme.css.
